name: Corridor segment, straight, ribbed
brief: MK-031 Corridor segment, straight, ribbed. Round 2, matched to the pick: the kit's base piece, 4 m on the 2 m grid, an octagonal tube with thick dark end frames and two mid ribs, off-white hull panels outside with small orange windows, and a warm inside: wall ribs, a grated floor with an orange wayfinding stripe (follow it home), a light strip, a pipe run and handholds for low gravity.

rounds.t: First build from the pack style and the Faceted Hero rules, no Midjourney pick yet.
Rebuilt against the Midjourney pick: chunky off-white modules held by dark bumper frames (bkit.module), warm orange windows (bkit.window), darker ground. Round 1 kept in round1/.
